description: Source code for managing credentials in a Git-like version control system, including functions for initializing, clearing, matching, configuring, reading, writing, and applying credentials, as well as handling credential helpers and URL parsing.

methods.name: void credential_init(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Initializes a credential structure with default values.

methods.name: void credential_clear(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears sensitive and other data from a credential structure.

methods.name: void credential_next_state(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prepares the credential structure for the next operation state.

methods.name: void credential_clear_secrets(struct credential * c)
methods.description: Clears sensitive secret fields from the credential.

methods.name: void credential_set_capability(struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Sets a specific capability flag on the credential.

methods.name: void credential_set_all_capabilities(struct credential * c,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Enables all capabilities for a credential.

methods.name: void credential_announce_capabilities(struct credential * c,FILE * fp)
methods.description: Outputs the capabilities of a credential.

methods.name: int credential_match(const struct credential * want,const struct credential * have,int match_password)
methods.description: Checks if two credentials match based on certain fields.

methods.name: int credential_config_callback(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * data)
methods.description: Callback for applying configuration variables to credentials.

methods.name: void credential_describe(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Creates a description of the credential URL.

methods.name: void credential_format(struct credential * c,struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Formats the credential into a URL string.

methods.name: char * credential_ask_one(const char * what,struct credential * c,int flags)
methods.description: Prompts the user to input a specific credential field.

methods.name: int credential_getpass(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Prompts the user for username and password if needed.

methods.name: int credential_has_capability(const struct credential_capability * capa,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Checks if a credential has a specific capability.

methods.name: int credential_read(struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Reads credential data from a file.

methods.name: void credential_write(const struct credential * c,FILE * fp,enum credential_op_type op_type)
methods.description: Writes credential data to a file.

methods.name: void credential_fill(struct repository * r,struct credential * c,int all_capabilities)
methods.description: Fills missing credential fields using helpers or prompts.

methods.name: void credential_approve(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Saves the credential after successful authentication.

methods.name: void credential_reject(struct repository * r,struct credential * c)
methods.description: Rejects/stores failure of a credential.

methods.name: void credential_from_url(struct credential * c,const char * url)
methods.description: Parses a complete URL into credential fields.

methods.name: int credential_from_url_gently(struct credential * c,const char * url,int quiet)
